req.title: Task deletion persists
req.statement: The system shall remove deleted rows so subsequent GET returns 404 for that id.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that deleting a task must persist the removal so that a subsequent GET returns 404. We need: (1) a positive test confirming DELETE returns 204 and GET then returns 404 (STC: exists→deleted state transition); (2) a negative test confirming DELETE on a non-existent id returns 404 (NEG); (3) a boundary test using the lowest valid pre-loaded id (id=1) and the id just beyond the highest (id=21) to probe boundary conditions (BVA). Additional tests cover idempotency (second DELETE returns 404) and exact status-code constants to kill comparison-operator mutations.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_task_returns_204_and_subsequent_get_returns_404
preconditions: Task with id=7 exists in the pre-loaded database (title='Fix login bug')
In-process FastAPI app is initialised with a fresh SQLite database seeded with 20 rows
actions: POST /tasks/ to create a fresh task so the test is self-contained
DELETE /tasks/{task_id} on the newly created task
expected: DELETE returns HTTP 204 with no body
trace: R-TASK-023: system shall remove deleted rows
R-TASK-023: subsequent GET returns 404 for that id
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_delete_existing_task_returns_204_and_subsequent_get_returns_404():
    client = TestClient(app)
    create_resp = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Temp task STC", "description": "desc", "completed": False})
    assert create_resp.status_code == 201
    task_id = create_resp.json()["id"]

    del_resp = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert del_resp.status_code == 204
    assert del_resp.content == b""

    get_resp = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert get_resp.status_code == 404
    body = get_resp.json()
    assert "detail" in body

test_delete_existing_task_returns_204_and_subsequent_get_returns_404()

tests.name: test_delete_is_idempotent_second_call_returns_404
preconditions: A task is created fresh for this test
actions: DELETE /tasks/{id} — second call on same id
expected: Second DELETE returns exactly 404 (row no longer exists)
trace: R-TASK-023: deleted rows are removed; re-deletion must fail with 404
DT: decision table row — task absent → delete returns False → 404
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_delete_is_idempotent_second_call_returns_404():
    client = TestClient(app)
    create_resp = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Idempotent delete test", "completed": False})
    assert create_resp.status_code == 201
    task_id = create_resp.json()["id"]

    first_del = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert first_del.status_code == 204

    second_del = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert second_del.status_code == 404
    body = second_del.json()
    assert "detail" in body

test_delete_is_idempotent_second_call_returns_404()

tests.name: test_delete_preloaded_task_id_7_persists_and_list_excludes_it
preconditions: Task with id=7 ('Fix login bug') exists in the pre-loaded database
actions: GET /tasks/7 to confirm existence before deletion
GET /tasks/?limit=100 and verify id=7 is absent from the list
expected: Task list does not contain any entry with id=7
trace: R-TASK-023: remove deleted rows so subsequent GET returns 404
EP: representative mid-range existing task id
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_delete_preloaded_task_id_7_persists_and_list_excludes_it():
    client = TestClient(app)
    pre = client.get("/tasks/7")
    assert pre.status_code == 200
    assert pre.json()["id"] == 7
    assert pre.json()["title"] == "Fix login bug"

    del_resp = client.delete("/tasks/7")
    assert del_resp.status_code == 204
    assert del_resp.content == b""

    get_resp = client.get("/tasks/7")
    assert get_resp.status_code == 404

    list_resp = client.get("/tasks/?limit=100")
    assert list_resp.status_code == 200
    ids = [t["id"] for t in list_resp.json()]
    assert 7 not in ids

test_delete_preloaded_task_id_7_persists_and_list_excludes_it()

tests.name: test_delete_boundary_just_above_max_preloaded_id_returns_404
preconditions: Pre-loaded data has 20 rows; id=20 is the maximum pre-loaded id
id=21 does not exist in the pre-loaded database
actions: DELETE /tasks/21 (one above the maximum pre-loaded id)
DELETE /tasks/20 (the maximum pre-loaded id, which exists)
expected: DELETE /tasks/20 returns exactly 204 (row exists and is removed)
trace: R-TASK-023: boundary at max pre-loaded id ±1
BVA: id=20 (at boundary, exists), id=21 (above boundary, absent)
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_delete_boundary_just_above_max_preloaded_id_returns_404():
    client = TestClient(app)
    above_max = client.delete("/tasks/21")
    assert above_max.status_code == 404
    assert "detail" in above_max.json()

    at_max = client.delete("/tasks/20")
    assert at_max.status_code == 204
    assert at_max.content == b""

    get_after = client.get("/tasks/20")
    assert get_after.status_code == 404

test_delete_boundary_just_above_max_preloaded_id_returns_404()
